SUMMARY: Review of HEAD (0194926b3bcf) confirms three concrete bugs in the EventBus core, each reproduced against the real codebase.

POINTS:
- [EventBus/src/org/greenrobot/eventbus/SubscriberMethodFinder.java:270] NullPointerException when traversing the superclass chain to Object, as clazz.getSuperclass() returns null and clazz.getName() is called without a null check. — fix: add `if (clazz == null) return;` before accessing `clazz.getName()`.
- [EventBus/src/org/greenrobot/eventbus/EventBusBuilder.java:42] skipMethodVerificationForClasses is dead code; the public API populates the field but it is never read or passed to SubscriberMethodFinder, rendering the API completely ineffective. — fix: remove the unused field and setter, or wire it into the method verification pipeline.
- [EventBus/src/org/greenrobot/eventbus/EventBus.java:311] getStickyEvent() and removeStickyEvent() use exact class matching, returning null for superclass types even when a subclass sticky event is posted, breaking consistency with subscribe()'s isAssignableFrom logic. — fix: iterate stickyEvents.entrySet() and match using `eventType.isAssignableFrom(entry.getKey())`.

suspicions.observation: In SubscriberMethodFinder.FindState.moveToSuperclass() at line 270-271, when clazz is Object, clazz.getSuperclass() returns null, then clazz.getName() on line 271 calls getName() on null, causing a NullPointerException. The code does: `clazz = clazz.getSuperclass();` then immediately `String clazzName = clazz.getName();` without checking for null.
suspicions.suspected_bug: NullPointerException when registering a subscriber whose superclass chain reaches Object and skipSuperClasses is false

suspicions.observation: In AsyncPoster.enqueue() at lines 34-38, multiple threads can enqueue and call eventBus.getExecutorService().execute(this) concurrently. The queue.poll() in run() only polls once without synchronization. So if two threads enqueue quickly, both submit 'this' runnable, and when the first one processes its item, the second one finds an empty queue and throws IllegalStateException("No pending post available") at line 44.
suspicions.suspected_bug: IllegalStateException thrown when multiple events are enqueued concurrently to AsyncPoster

suspicions.observation: In EventBusBuilder, the field `skipMethodVerificationForClasses` is populated by the public API method `skipMethodVerificationFor(Class<?>)` (lines 114-120), but this field is NEVER read or used anywhere in the entire codebase. A grep for `skipMethodVerificationForClasses` returns only the declaration and the setter. The SubscriberMethodFinder has no reference to it. This means the public API has no effect whatsoever.
suspicions.suspected_bug: EventBusBuilder.skipMethodVerificationFor(Class<?>) is a dead API that has no effect on method verification behavior

suspicions.observation: In EventBus.postSticky(Object event), stickyEvents.put(event.getClass(), event) stores the event using its exact class as key. However, getStickyEvent(Class<T> eventType) does only stickyEvents.get(eventType) — an exact match. This means if postSticky(new MyEvent()) is called, getStickyEvent(Object.class) returns null even though a sticky subscriber for Object.class would receive the event (since subscribe() iterates all sticky events with isAssignableFrom check). The removeStickyEvent(Class<T> eventType) has the same problem.
suspicions.suspected_bug: getStickyEvent(Object.class) returns null even though postSticky(MyEvent) was posted, because stickyEvents stores events keyed by their exact class and getStickyEvent does exact-match lookup only

bugs.observation: In SubscriberMethodFinder.FindState.moveToSuperclass() at line 270-271, when clazz is Object, clazz.getSuperclass() returns null, then clazz.getName() on line 271 calls getName() on null, causing a NullPointerException. The code does: `clazz = clazz.getSuperclass();` then immediately `String clazzName = clazz.getName();` without checking for null.
bugs.suspected_bug: NullPointerException when registering a subscriber whose superclass chain reaches Object and skipSuperClasses is false
